_meta.source: Kerbalism source at the pinned kerbalism-src checkout: an EVA kerbal IS its own real Vessel (single Part, stock KSP mechanic - System/Callbacks.cs's ToEVA/DelayedOnEVA runs on GameEvents.onCrewOnEva, transferring a share of the origin vessel's resources onto the new EVA Part/Vessel). What actually rides on the suit: Profile/Supply.cs's SetupEva only attaches a PartResource for a Supply whose on_eva is nonzero. In the shipped default profile (GameData/KerbalismConfig/Profiles/Default.cfg) that is exactly two resources - ElectricCharge (on_eva = 33.0) and Oxygen (on_eva = 12.5, commented '2 hrs' in the source) - real resource names, no suit-specific aliasing, no CarbonDioxide, no recall mechanic (grepped kerbalism-src for 'recall' case-insensitively: zero matches). Oxygen depletion rate below (0.00172379825/s) is the real breathing Rule's configured rate (Profile/Rule.cs, GameData/KerbalismConfig/Profiles/Default.cfg's breathing Rule): 12.5 / 0.00172379825 ~= 7250s ~= 2.01h, matching the config comment. The ElectricCharge drain rate is not similarly grounded (EC draw on an EVA kerbal comes from the climatization Rule's temperature/volume-dependent modifier product, not statically computable from config alone) - marked ungrounded below.
_meta.widgetSource: This fixture now uses CrewManifest's real read surfaces end to end: kerbalism.crew (per-kerbal rule accumulators, already consumed by SurvivalMeters) and the generic, already-existing vessel.resources Topic (Sitrep.Contract.VesselResources - {resources: {[name]: {current, max, active}}}, already consumed elsewhere by FuelStatus) for the EVA suit O2/EC readout added to CrewManifest/index.tsx alongside this fixture. The active 'vessel' IS Jebediah on EVA (vessel.identity.vesselType=7, VesselType.EVA), so vessel.crew reports a 1/1 roster of just him and vessel.resources reports his suit's own resource pool - no new wire protocol, no invented fields. Superseded from the prior version of this fixture: an invented 'evaSuit' object nested under kerbalism.crew (nothing in the widget ever read it) and a proposed-but-nonexistent 'recallSec' field - both removed. The suit's Oxygen amount below (1.9/12.5, ~15%) is chosen to sit in the fixture's 'low O2' name; ElectricCharge (6.1/33.0, ~18%) is set low too so both meters read amber/red in the render rather than only one.
ungrounded: vessel.resources.resources.ElectricCharge - the specific current amount (6.1) is illustrative for the 'low O2' scenario, not derived from a specific Kerbalism climatization-rule computation

kerbalism.crew[0].rules[breathing].value (0.85) - chosen to read as 'high' alongside the low Oxygen amount above for a coherent scenario, not computed from Rule.Execute's actual degen-per-second formula

vessel.orbit below - deriveVesselState (vessel-state.ts) produces no record at all, isEVA included, until vessel.orbit is whole (see CrewManifest/index.test.tsx's own ORBIT comment), so a plausible circular Kerbin orbit is emitted purely to unblock the isEVA derivation; this widget never renders any orbit-derived field
